title: SD-LoRA: Training-Time Structural Distillation into LoRA for Few-Shot Vision-Language Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Few-shot adaptation of vision-language models must balance two competing goals: learning fine-grained visual distinctions from very limited supervision and preserving the efficiency that makes frozen CLIP-like models attractive for deployment. Existing lightweight adaptation methods, including prompt tuning, LoRA, and cache-based adapters, typically supervise global image embeddings and therefore underuse token-level structure. Conversely, structure-aware methods exploit local evidence but often introduce additional inference-time computation. We propose SD-LoRA, a structural distillation framework that uses token-level graph reasoning only during training and transfers its effects into a lightweight LoRA-adapted CLIP model. translated_title: SD-LoRA：面向少样本视觉-语言适配的训练时结构蒸馏至LoRA
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型的少样本适配必须平衡两个相互竞争的目标：一方面要从极其有限的监督中学习细粒度的视觉差异，另一方面要保留冻结的类CLIP模型在部署中极具吸引力的效率。现有的轻量级适配方法，包括提示调优、LoRA和基于缓存的适配器，通常只监督全局图像嵌入，因此未能充分利用token级别的结构信息。相反，结构感知方法虽然利用了局部证据，但往往会引入额外的推理时计算。我们提出SD-LoRA，这是一种结构蒸馏框架，仅在训练期间使用token级别的图推理，并将其效果迁移到轻量级的LoRA适配CLIP模型中。在训练期间，一个异构图教师在高分辨率ViT token上建模patch-patch、全局-局部以及视觉-文本关系。SD-LoRA并不在测试时保留该图结构，而是将其结构信息迁移……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: SD-LoRA提出一种结构蒸馏框架，仅在训练时通过异构图教师进行token级图推理（建模patch间、全局-局部及视觉-文本关系），并将其效果迁移至轻量级LoRA适配的CLIP模型，在不增加推理开销的前提下提升少样本视觉-语言适配能力。
en_tdlr: SD-LoRA distills training-time token-level graph reasoning from a heterogeneous graph teacher into a lightweight LoRA-adapted CLIP, enhancing few-shot vision-language adaptation without adding inference-time computation.
